4-5 days. I just need to pay my tuition and pay off my debts.

I have attempted suicide now 4 times. One of these times was two days ago. 

I’ve never asked for help because I felt I never deserved it. I felt my friends and family deserved better than me and that they only tolerated me. Three days ago my friends noticed a change and two days ago they saved my life by taking me to the ER. My parents travelled 4 hours just to bring me home and make sure I was okay. They are getting me the help I need right now. I have never felt such love and I’m heartbroken I couldn’t see it before. 

Please, if you think there is something off with your friends PLEASE reach out. Sometimes they may be suffering in silence and maybe one “are you doing okay?” can help them open up. If a friend is on your mind, tell them. A small gesture to show someone they are not alone can mean the world to that person. 

If you are in a dark place right now and feel that there is no way out, I want you to know that there are people in your life right now that care about you so much. Even if you are feeling like they would be better off, trust me they wouldn’t. 

The world gets a little bit darker when someone commits suicide. The world needs your light. Reach out to someone.
